name: std::collate<CharT>::transform, do_transform

declarations.code:
public:
string_type transform(const CharT *low, const CharT *high) const;

protected:
virtual string_type do_transform(const CharT *low, const CharT *high) const;

intro:
1) Public member function, calls the protected virtual member function do_transform of the most derived class.

2) Converts the character sequence [low, high) to a string that, compared lexicographically (e.g. with operator< for strings) with the result of calling transform() on another string, produces the same result as calling do_compare() on the same two strings.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
low

 -

 pointer to the first character in the sequence to transform


 high

 -

 one past the end pointer for the sequence to transform

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The string transformed so that lexicographic comparison of the transformed strings may be used instead of collating of the originals. In the "C" locale, the returned string is the exact copy of [low, high). In other locales, the contents of the returned string are implementation-defined, and the size may be considerably longer.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: In addition to the use in collation, the implementation-specific format of the transformed string is known to std::regex_traits<>::transform_primary, which is able to extract the equivalence class information.

examples.output:
In the Swedish locale: år before ängel
In lexicographic comparison: ängel before år
